description:
Windows Installer Packaging Tool for Developers, ISVs & Enterprises

Advanced Installer is a Windows installer authoring tool for installing, updating, and configuring your products safely, securely, and reliably.
New Features
- Redesigned Custom Actions view for easier management

Enhancements
- Update MSIX StartUp Task
- Azure Key Vault signing improvements
- PowerShell automation for Dialog View
- PowerShell automation for Digital Signature in Updates project type
- PowerShell automation for "Store setting inside the Updater" option
- Added regex support to the include and exclude filters in the Synchronized Folders tab
- Improved notification visibility by displaying the most recent notifications first and adding timestamps
- Improved the usability of generated Repackager automation scripts
- Improved exposure of the "AiLicenseAgreementLink" property for the Serene theme in a Professional project type
- Support for specifying either internal and external executable paths in Sparse Packages
- Added Vietnamese dictionary
- Improved Repackager capture by excluding the Uninstall registry key
- Updated "ComponentName" after resource renaming (e.g. registry; folder)
- Improved name identifier for data setters
- Predefined launch conditions for Windows 11 26H2
- Updated .NET 8 prerequisites to the latest version 8.0.31
- Updated .NET 9 prerequisites to the latest version 9.0.20
- Updated .NET 10 prerequisites to the latest version 10.0.12

Fixed Bugs
- Setup failed when the driver's feature was set not to be installed
- Fixed title bar display over other windows
- Adding drivers to a mixed package led to a build crash
- A Main Package prerequisite was not installed when the setup was launched with /qn+
- The "Register product with Windows Installer" did not work on EXE packages or EUI/MSI Embedded UI
- Crash when clicking on a hyperlink
- The Cancel button did not stop the installation process
- Couldn’t delete the first letter from the custom action name when editing from the middle of the name
- Adding file association to an MSIX build led to failure when parsing the package
- An error message appeared when trying to install a prerequisite using "Repair" on the main package
- /GenRegLicense command line reported "File could not be written" when custom license element value exceeded five characters
- The "QuestionnaireDlg" dialog couldn’t be used or added to repository
- A formatted reference created a property with an empty name
- Updated the "SetAzureKeyVaultSecret" cmd to support the Updates project type
- Pressing ENTER when saving a project file opened a new project
- Button IDs differed between desktop and server when WinUI was enabled
- "Signup" was displayed instead of "Sign up" in the Installer Analytics CTA link text
- A chained prerequisite inherited the "BasicUIComLine" attribute from a previously created prerequisite
- Editing MSIX sometimes caused a silent crash
- The Search option in the Run pane was bigger than the Summary
- Registry entries from the template were removed when importing a Repackager project
- Fixed issues on the Registration details SSO dialog
- Signing a catalog file failed if its path contained the "#" character
- PowerShell automation failed to build the Updates Configuration project when the Digital Signature option was set
- The "Synchronize" button disappeared in Repackager
- Custom templates were duplicated after certain steps
- ConfigureDlg did not work correctly in version 24.0
- Crash when upgrading a project from the File Registration dialog
- Custom Templates were available even if there were no custom templates saved
- The /GenRegKeys CLI did not take the long/short parameter into consideration
- StartUp Task had no default Entry point in Windows Store project type
- Stack trace error when using the /GenerateReport command line
- Page Count incorrectly set to 450 for ARM64 package type setup
